_comment: scan-fill job — apply reconciled research-agent outputs to EXISTING exercises.
Claude does the scanning/research/reconciliation; the runner does only the
deterministic writes and NEVER sets an approving review value (it stamps the
neutral review_status=unreviewed / machine_clearance=unevaluated).
Runner: scripts/runners/scan_fill.py (kind: scan-fill).
'_comment' is ignored by the runner — it reads only the keys below via plan.get().
plan.json fields:
kind  : must be 'scan-fill'.
env   : MCP registration name; `--env` overrides it.
batch : non-empty list of exercise carespaceIds. For EACH cid there must be a
sibling file records/<cid>.json (loaded by run_job.py).
records/<cid>.json shape (NOTE the exact keys — the runner is case-sensitive:
'classA' has a capital A, 'classb' is lowercase b):
documentId : the exercise's documentId (required; target of update_exercise).
scalars    : object of plain exercise fields to set (e.g. instructions,
description, breathing, laterality, default_reps ...).
relations  : { exercise_positions, joints, body_regions, reasons, equipment }
each an array of canonical names resolved to relations at run time.
classA     : { tags, functional_goals, exercise_target_muscle_groups } — each an
array of names that MUST be canonical (checked against
references/controlled-vocabularies.json before the write).
classb     : per-exercise sub-content, each created fresh then linked —
common_mistakes            : [ { description } ],
feedback_points            : [ { description } ],
warm_up_suggestions        : [ { description, duration } ],
cool_down_recommendations  : [ { description, duration } ],
progression_steps          : [ { step, description } ] (sorted by step),
modification_options       : { description, level } (level MUST be canonical
against exercise-modification-option-level).
